cohort: The study included pregnant women from Qianfoshan Hospital who completed questionnaires and a subset underwent objective sleep monitoring using actigraphy devices.
finding: The sleep situation of pregnant women worsens throughout pregnancy, and first-trimester sleep patterns are associated with the occurrence of pregnancy-induced hypertension (PIH) and mode of delivery.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was associated with sleep duration, sleep efficiency, and PSQI scores measured in the first trimester of pregnancy.
